hypothesis: A universal source-bound uint32 proof rejects wrong packed decoder changes locally before GPU allocation. It does not improve runtime.
implementation: Independent Lean4.35 BitVec specification and kernel-checked proofs; no released author Lean package found.
correctness: Four universal output identities for all 2^32 words; source-position bijection; two supporting lemmas; four generated-source identities; 11 axiom reports with standard dependencies only.
critic_findings_resolved: C++ backslash-newline splicing precedes comment stripping; LF/CRLF regression fixtures added.
Direct packing-map mutations and modeled macro overrides rejected; indirect aliases and surrounding environment explicitly outside certification.
Default native bitvector checker removed; retained kernel proof uses bit extensionality, simp, omega and finite decide.
Leading-zero/octal literals rejected to avoid decimal/C++ interpretation differences.
performance: No runtime source change; direct speed gain zero.
decision: Keep as source-bound fragment preflight. Unsupported expressions require a reviewed new model; full numerics, memory, dispatch and concurrency remain unproved.
next: Use --verify-ptx on future compatible MoE candidates; extend only for concrete rewrite contracts and retain official GPU validation.
